checks.name: JavaScript module syntax
checks.detail: v11 model parses; v11 viewer module parses. Control IDs are unique and all queried IDs are defined.

checks.name: Desktop geometry smoke test
checks.detail: 520 mesh objects, 11 parts, 290 fastener instances, 2 track groups in isolated Three-compatible object graph.

checks.name: Mobile geometry smoke test
checks.detail: 520 mesh objects, 11 parts, 290 fastener instances (same geometry), two moving track assemblies.

checks.name: Suspension existence
checks.detail: A. Batanov/V. Lositsky retrospective describes deformed balance arms and their field repair in Pripyat in early 1987.

checks.name: Suspension geometry
checks.detail: Three paired rockers and one seventh-wheel support per side are explicit visual hypotheses; no factory dimensions or pairing topology documented.

checks.name: Actuator motion extremes
checks.detail: 31 pose samples; six indicative actuator lengths remained finite/positive, .547..1.008 model units.

checks.name: Photographic overlay
checks.detail: Dedicated orthographic camera and opacity/scale/X/Y manual alignment controls; no live GPU screen check, no camera calibration, no calculated accuracy.

checks.name: Photographic source separation
checks.detail: Source selection disables manual overlay for independent two-robot image, since perspective/pose differ.

checks.name: Old note migration
checks.detail: Stable local storage key with fallback to v9 notes, preserving prior observations in the same browser.

checks.name: Real GPU WebGL rendering
checks.detail: No successful direct browser WebGL screenshot or click-through evaluation; user-device verification outstanding.

checks.name: Historical dimensional/kinematic accuracy
checks.detail: No actual scale, complete photogrammetry, manufacturer assembly drawing or verified pivot geometry.

blockers: Historical image is perspective; automatic metric comparison would require camera/lens calibration and at least one known physical dimension.
No first-party original mechanical drawing or reliable wheel/balancer topology currently identified.
Two-robot archival photo is qualitatively useful but different pose/viewpoint cannot be used for orthographic point-by-point comparison.
Real GPU WebGL renderer and overlay functionality need mobile/desktop visual testing.
External review not required for publication, but provenance and uncertainty must remain visible.
status: Prototype v11 geometry and UI implemented and syntactically checked. Do not claim a higher historical-accuracy score until photo and dimensional validation.
